items.headline: America: FAA ne saari udaanen roki
items.detail: America me air traffic control ke telecom outage ke baad FAA ne desh bhar me saari departing flights rok di — 11 September 2001 ke baad sirf doosri baar aisa nationwide ground stop laga; lagbhag 7,000 flights late ya cancel hui, hamle ka koi sanket nahi.
items.exam_angle: America ke hawai yatayat niyantran tantra ki kamzori aur rashtriya suraksha par asar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Niger: bazaar ja rahe 37 nagrikon ki hatya
items.detail: Paschimi Niger ke Tillaberi kshetra me bazaar ja rahe gaon walon par ghaat lagakar hamla hua — kam se kam 37 log mare gaye, jinme mahilayen aur bachche bhi shamil; hamlaavaron ki pehchan abhi nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Sahel kshetra me jihadist hinsa aur Tillaberi tri-border sankat — Africa ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Putin: Europe bhi Ukraine shaanti vaarta me
items.detail: Kremlin me American dooton se baat ke baad Putin ne agle daur ki Ukraine shaanti vaarta me European pratinidhiyon ko shamil karne par sahmati di — halanki Kremlin ne baad me sanket diya ki antim faisla abhi baki hai; Zelensky ne sambhavna ka swagat kiya.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shaanti vaarta me Europe ki bhumika aur Russia-America kootneeti — antarrashtriya sambandhon ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump, Xi, Putin: pehli baar teenon ki baithak
items.detail: White House ne pushti ki — 19 November ko Shenzhen me APEC ke kinare America, China aur Russia ke neta parmanu hathiyar kam karne aur Iran yuddh par baat karenge; koi samjhauta hone ki ummeed nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Teen bade parmanu shaktiyon ki pehli trilateral baithak — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Microsoft outage doosre din bhi jaari
items.detail: Outlook, Teams aur Copilot 70 se zyada deshon me do din se band ya dheeme rahe; Microsoft ne kaha mool wajah suljha li gayi hai aur cyber hamla nahi tha, lekin poori bahali ka koi samay nahi diya.
items.exam_angle: Mahatvapurna digital sevaon par nirbharta aur unki kamzori — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Netherlands: tax par sarkar girne ke kagar par
items.detail: PM Rob Jetten ne saat ghante ki sankat baithak ke baad kaha weekend me aur baatchit hogi; VVD ne sarkar ko 'failed experiment' kaha, tax package par gathbandhan me gehra matbhed hai.

items.headline: America: 4 ghante baad udaanen phir shuru
items.detail: FAA ne desh bhar ka ground stop hata liya — 4 ghante se zyada ki rukawat ke baad udaanen phir shuru hui; lagbhag 4,700 udaanen radd aur 10,000 deri se chali, cyber hamle ka koi sanket nahi mila.
items.exam_angle: 9/11 ke baad sirf doosri baar America bhar me udaanen roki gayi — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump ne tel waiver 90 din badhaya
items.detail: Trump ne Jones Act ki chhoot 90 din ke liye badha di — videshi jahaaz ab America ke bandargaahon ke beech tel aur saaman le ja sakenge, taaki Iran yuddh ke beech tel ke daam kam rahen.
items.exam_angle: Jones Act 100 saal purana America ka shipping kanoon hai — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Turkiye ne Mecca raksha samjhaute ko manzoori di
items.detail: Turkiye ne Mecca raksha samjhaute ko manzoori dene wala kanoon sarkari gazette me chhapa — sansad ne 5 November ko manzoori di thi; samjhauta tab lagu hoga jab aakhri dastavej jama hoga.
items.exam_angle: Teen deshon ka samjhauta: ek par hamla sab par hamla — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Turkiye aur Qatar ne raksha samjhauta kiya
items.detail: Turkiye aur Qatar ne Istanbul me paraspar raksha samjhauta kiya — kisi ek par bahari hamla dono par hamla mana jayega; sanyukt abhyas aur raksha udyog me sahyog bhi hoga.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me badhte raksha gathbandhan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nakli video call se $400 million ki chori
items.detail: Uttar Korea ke hackers ne nakli Zoom aur Teams call aur chori ki webcam video se 18 mahine me 400 million dollar se zyada ki crypto churai; FBI ne 900 se zyada video jabt kiye.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha aur deepfake ka badhta khatra — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Baltic me Russian jahaaz par drone hamla
items.detail: Ukraine ne Finland ki khaadi me Russian missile corvette Naro-Fominsk par drone hamla kiya; Finland aur Estonia ne hamle ki pushti ki — nagrik samudri kshetra me pehla aisa hamla.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh ka Baltic sagar me vistaar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Starship kaksha me, booster samundar me gira
items.detail: SpaceX ki Starship 15th test flight me doosri baar kaksha me pahunchi aur 26 Starlink satellite chhode, lekin Super Heavy booster catch ke bajay Gulf of Mexico me gira aur jal utha; jahaaz aaj shaam launch tower par pakde jaane ki koshish karega.
items.exam_angle: Punah-upyog yogya rocket takneek; Chand aur Mangal mission ki taiyari.

items.headline: Hormuz me do tanker par mine dhamaka
items.detail: IRGC Navy ke daave ke mutabik Hormuz Strait me bina anumati ke raste se ja rahe do tel tanker samudri surang se takraakar dhamake ke baad jal uthe — ek supertanker bhi shamil; jahaazon ke naam aur nuksan ki jaankari abhi nahi mili.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait se duniya ke tel vyapar ka bada hissa guzarta hai; Paschim Asia me tanav.

items.headline: Qatar Airways ki Riyadh, Dammam udaanen phir shuru
items.detail: Qatar Airways ne ek mahine se zyada ke antaral ke baad Riyadh (13 November) aur Dammam (14 November) ke liye rozana udaanen phir shuru kar di — October me Riyadh hawai adde par hamle ke baad seva band hui thi; Abha aur Taif abhi bhi band hain.

items.headline: ICC ne America sainikon ki jaanch band ki
items.detail: ICC ke nyayadhishon ne Afghanistan me America ke sainikon par kathit apradhon ki jaanch aupcharik roop se band kar di — ab sirf 2021 ke baad Taliban ke karwaiyon par dhyaan rahega; abhiyojak ne faisle ke khilaf appeal ki hai.
items.exam_angle: ICC ki jaanch par America ke pratibandh aur antarrashtriya kanoon par asar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UN ne Houthi pratibandh ek saal aur badhaye
items.detail: UN Suraksha Parishad ne sarvasammati se Yemen se jude pratibandh — sampatti zabt aur yatra pratibandh — 14 November 2027 tak badha diye; Houthiyon ko drone-missile banane wale saaman ki aapurti rokne par bhi kadam uthaye gaye.
items.exam_angle: UNSC ke pratibandh aur Yemen sankat — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
